_comments.defaultCwd: Where sessions start. Empty = ~/dev if it exists, else $HOME.
_comments.claudeBin: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = auto-detect.
_comments.model: Empty = whatever your claude CLI defaults to. Or e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku'.
_comments.yolo: 'true' passes --dangerously-skip-permissions (headless runs can't answer prompts). 'false' uses acceptEdits.
_comments.ownerName: What the assistant calls you when reporting on background work.
_comments.timeoutMs: Kill a task after this long. Default 30 minutes.
_comments.staleSec: Ignore messages older than this (e.g. queued while the machine slept). Default 1 hour.
_comments.openaiApiKey: Optional. For Whisper voice-note transcription. Usually better set as $OPENAI_API_KEY.
_comments.env-override: Any key can be overridden with BRIDGE_<UPPER_SNAKE_CASE>, e.g. BRIDGE_DEFAULT_CWD.
